{{Top|leg}}
A '''code dealer''' was an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who could supply the passcodes to access certain restricted [[NewsNet]] channels. The channels were usually of an illegal nature, and the codes were only supplied to trusted individuals, or those that had been recommended to the code dealer by an existing customer. The infochant [[ConJob]] on [[Tanquilla Beach/Legends|''Tanquilla Beach'']] was a code dealer who could supply the codes to access [[Cynabar's InfoNet]].
